# Success Business Advisors

> Success Business Advisors (SB Advisors FZ LLC) is a UAE-based accounting, tax, and corporate services firm headquartered in Ras Al Khaimah. We serve SMEs, founders, and finance teams across the UAE with corporate tax, VAT, accounting, audit support, AML/ESR/UBO compliance, business setup, and CFO advisory.

## About

- Legal name: SB Advisors FZ LLC
- Trade name: Success Business Advisors
- Headquarters: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971-7-207-7417
- Email: info@sbadvisors.ae
- Website: https://www.sbadvisors.ae
- Areas served: United Arab Emirates (Ras Al Khaimah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and all other emirates and free zones)

## Services

- [Tax support — Corporate Tax & VAT consultancy](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tax-support-corporate-tax-vat-consultancy-ras-al-khaimah-uae/): UAE corporate tax registration and filing, VAT registration and returns, transfer pricing, tax residency certificates, Free Zone QFZP analysis.
- [Accounting & finance — outsourced CFO services](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/accounting-finance-consulting-cfo-services-ras-al-khaimah-uae/): bookkeeping, management accounts, IFRS-compliant financial statements, audit support, fractional and outsourced CFO engagements.
- [Compliance — AML, due diligence, ESR, UBO, risk management](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/compliance-aml-due-diligence-esr-risk-management-ras-al-khaimah-uae/): AML programmes for DNFBPs, goAML registration and STR support, Economic Substance Regulations filings, Ultimate Beneficial Owner reporting, KYC and risk assessments.
- [Financial planning, cost control, and business setup](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/financial-planning-cost-control-business-setup-ras-al-khaimah-uae/): UAE company formation (mainland, free zone, offshore), licensing, budgeting, cost-control reviews, banking introductions.

## Free tools

- [UAE Corporate Tax Calculator](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tools/corporate-tax-calculator/): estimates the 9% corporate tax liability with Small Business Relief and Free Zone QFZP scenarios.
- [VAT Return Estimator](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tools/vat-return-estimator/): estimates net VAT payable, models reverse-charge imports, and surfaces FTA filing deadlines.
- [Business Setup Cost Estimator](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tools/business-setup-cost-estimator/): first-year all-in cost across RAK ICC, RAKEZ, Dubai free zones, ADGM, DIFC, and mainland.
- [ESR / UBO / AML Compliance Checker](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tools/esr-ubo-aml-compliance-checker/): determines which of the three regimes apply to a UAE entity.
- [Free Zone vs Mainland Decision Tool](https://www.sbadvisors.ae/tools/free-zone-vs-mainland/): compares ownership, tax, banking, and operational trade-offs.
